title: 5.6 Graphing Linear Inequalities in Two Variables

icans: I can check solutions of linear inequalities in two variables.
I can graph linear inequalities in two variables.
I can write and use linear inequalities for real-life problems.

vocab: an ordered pair that makes the _____________ true
the side of the boundary line that contains the ____________

blocks.p: Test each point in y < x + 1. Plot the points that work in one color and the others in another color.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Boundary line: Boundary line: _______________ for < or >, _______________ for ≤ or ≥.
Test point: Test a point not on the line. If it is true, shade _______________ side.

blocks.stem: You can spend at most $30 on movies ($10 each) and snacks ($3 each). Write an inequality. Can you buy 2 movies and 4 snacks?
A dashed line passes through (0, −1) and (1, 1), and the region above it is shaded. Write the inequality.

tickets.stem: Is (0, 0) a solution of y ≥ x − 4?
Is the boundary of y < 3x + 1 solid or dashed?
For y ≥ −x + 2, do you shade above or below the line?
